author: @GENO
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,动漫 / 漫画,电影感 / 电影剧照,群像 / 情侣
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a 4-by-4 storyboard contact sheet of a cinematic anime samurai duel, designed as separable shots for animation. The scene follows a long-haired female ronin in a soaked crimson kimono fighting a rugged male samurai in a dark navy kimono in a rain-drenched Edo-period temple courtyard at night. Make the faces intentionally anonymized with soft dark square censor blocks over visible faces, while preserving hair, clothing, weapons, and action poses.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 image, arranged as exactly 16 rectangular cinematic frames in a clean 4 columns by 4 rows grid, with thin white gutters between panels. Each panel should feel like a different camera shot from the same fight sequence. Use dramatic low-key lighting, wet reflective ground, rain streaks, drifting red petals, lantern glow, motion blur, sword glints, sparks, and splashes. Style: highly detailed dark anime film stills, painterly realism, dynamic composition, intense choreography, shallow depth of field, moody blue-black shadows with crimson accents.

Panel count and content: Include exactly 16 panels:
1. Wide establishing shot: both warriors face each other across the wet courtyard, red warrior on the left, blue warrior on the right, swords drawn, temple building and lanterns behind them.
2. Close-up action shot of the red warrior thrusting a katana toward camera, hair whipping in rain, face covered by a dark square.
3. Close-up action shot of the blue warrior gripping his katana defensively, blade angled forward, face covered by a dark square.
4. Side-view clash: red warrior lunges from the left while blue warrior counters from the right, rain and petals swirling.
5. Low side shot: swords collide with a bright burst of sparks between the fighters.
6. Dynamic tracking shot: red warrior spins or slashes horizontally, red sleeves flowing, bright sword arc crossing the frame.
7. Blue warrior mid-guard with a katana sweeping through rain, multiple blue-white motion trails around the blade.
8. Tight two-shot: red and blue warriors locked close in a blade bind, wet hair and blood flecks visible, both faces obscured.
9. Acrobatic shot: red warrior flips upside down over the courtyard roofline or walkway, sword extended, rain streaks and motion blur emphasizing speed.
10. Medium close-up of the blue warrior looking upward or turning with his katana ready, temple lights blurred behind him, face obscured.
11. Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the blue warrior as the red warrior leaps down with raised sword beneath pink blossoms.
12. Extreme close clash: crossed blades near the camera with a starburst of sparks, blue warrior partially hidden by a dark face block.
13. Close-up of the red warrior performing a powerful slash, crimson sleeve and hair sweeping across the frame, face obscured.
14. Impact shot: the blue warrior is struck across the chest or shoulder, dark red blood sprays across his navy robe, face obscured.
15. Wide standoff reset: red warrior stands in the foreground with sword lowered while the blue warrior crouches at distance in front of the temple, rain pooling on the ground.
16. Final portrait close-up of the red warrior in rain, crimson robe stained and hair framing the face, large dark square obscuring the face.

Constraints: Keep the grid layout exact, with 16 distinct shots and consistent characters, outfits, swords, weather, and setting across all panels. No captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Emphasize cinematic action continuity, wet fabric texture, realistic sword metal, glowing lantern reflections, and high-contrast rain-night atmosphere. Overall mood should be tragic, brutal, elegant, and suspenseful.\

prompt_en: Cristiano Ronaldo sports poster, the concept — a single photograph printed in four completely different color treatments — side by side — divided into four equal vertical strips — each strip the same image — each strip a different color world — Andy Warhol Marilyn logic — but applied to sports photography not celebrity portraiture — the repetition reveals — that he is simultaneously many things — and always the same thing, the photograph — full body — mid bicycle kick — body fully inverted — shot from below — the most architecturally complex silhouette a body can make — all four strips show this same moment — but in four realities, strip one — left — background warm cream Pantone 9183C — figure in deep charcoal — almost monochrome — one accent — signal red Pantone 485C — on the boot making contact — and on the number 7 — the design language of Images 2 3 4 — technical — precise — information annotations in the cream zones, strip two — background electric cobalt Pantone 2728C — figure in white — high contrast — reversed out — white silhouette on blue — Yves Klein territory — pure color pure form — no details — just the shape he makes — in the upper zone of the blue — white Japanese kanji — 空 — kū — void — sky — air — the element he masters, strip three — background deep forest green Pantone 349C — figure in warm gold Pantone 130C — the Portugal colors — inverted from their usual relationship — green and gold — not green and red — the color of money — the color of victory — the color of what he has accumulated — trophies rendered as small gold silhouettes in the green background zones, strip four — right — background absolute black — figure in vermillion Pantone 179C — the most aggressive strip — the heat strip — his silhouette burning — like a thermal image — like a heat signature — the body as energy source — as engine — as system running at maximum, between strips — dividing lines — 1px — alternating between bone white and signal red — thin but present — the seams of four realities — the frame of a contact sheet — the grid of a color separation, across all four strips — running full poster width — ignoring the strip divisions — one typographic element — positioned at exact vertical center — RONALDO — in a different color on each strip — red on cream — white on blue — black on gold — gold on black — the name changing its appearance — never changing its meaning, bottom of poster — below all four strips — a single unifying band — black — full width — containing in white — Helvetica Neue Light — 8pt tracking 600 — four statements — one per strip — separated by thin rules — DISCIPLINE / ARTISTRY / OBSESSION / LEGEND, the band unifies what the strips separate — one man — four dimensions — all true — simultaneously.\

prompt_en: Create a warm cinematic vertical illustration of a young female artist sitting in a cozy, plant-filled painting studio on a rainy day, surrounded by exactly three black cats. The artist is shown in three-quarter profile from behind/side, seated on the floor beside a wooden easel, with a large messy high bun of chestnut brown hair, wearing a loose dark charcoal long-sleeve blouse and a cream skirt or loose cream trousers. Her face is intentionally obscured by a simple centered square block of flat medium brown color, covering the facial features while leaving the hair, neck, hand, and pose visible. She holds a thin paintbrush near her mouth with one hand, while the cat on the easel reaches up and touches or bats at the brush with one paw. Include exactly three black cats: one in the lower left foreground looking up with large golden eyes, one on the left midground leaping or stretching near a doorway with tail raised and bright yellow eyes, and one on the right perched on the easel ledge, gazing at the brush with one raised paw. The studio is lush and atmospheric, with many potted green plants around a tall sunlit window, a wooden table with pots and flowers, white daisies blooming near the left side, an angled canvas on the easel at the right, jars and cups of paintbrushes in the bottom right foreground, and scattered warm painterly details. Use rainy-day golden window light with soft backlighting, glowing dust motes, wet reflective ambience, and a nostalgic quiet mood. Style should be detailed anime-inspired painterly realism, rich texture, dramatic golden-hour lighting, deep shadows, warm amber highlights, expressive cats, high detail, vertical 3:4 composition, no visible text, no watermark.\

title: 电影动漫照片比较
author: طالب

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a side-by-side comparison image showing a realistic reference-style photo on the left and a luxurious cinematic Japanese anime transformation on the right, featuring the same child pose, outfit, background, and framing.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 2-panel layout, approximately 1036×573 pixels, with a clean vertical split down the center. No captions, no labels, no watermark.

Layout: Use exactly 2 panels. Left panel: soft, slightly blurry phone-photo realism. Right panel: polished cinematic anime film still. Keep the same full-body composition in both panels: a young girl standing indoors against a wall, one hand raised and touching vertical black wooden slats, the other hand resting on her hip, body facing forward, camera at a slightly low child-height angle.

Subject details: The character is a young girl with very long dark brown hair and a deliberately blurred square face for privacy. Preserve the pose precisely: left arm raised with palm on the wall slats, right hand on hip, feet close together, relaxed confident stance. Hair should fall past the shoulders and become more dramatic and wind-swept in the anime panel.

Outfit: Show exactly 4 visible clothing pieces: 1 pale pink zip hoodie, 1 white T-shirt with the small text “alo” on the chest, 1 pair of pale pink jogger sweatpants with the small text “alo” near the pocket and dark side stripes, and 1 pair of light sneakers. Use pale blush pink as the main tracksuit color. Keep the same clothing design in both panels.

Environment: Indoor modern wall with exactly 3 main visible background surfaces: dark marble panel on the far left, vertical black wooden slat panel behind the raised hand, and gray plaster/concrete wall to the right. Include a light floor and a thin baseboard. In the right anime panel, enhance the environment with warm golden sunlight, soft dust particles, stronger shadows, painterly marble texture, and cinematic depth.

Visual style: Left panel should resemble the original casual photo: natural lighting, muted gray tones, slight lens softness, realistic proportions. Right panel should look like a high-end Japanese anime movie still: detailed line art, refined cel shading, warm rim light from the upper right, volumetric glow, realistic fabric folds, expressive hair strands, polished cinematic color grading, and dramatic but faithful composition.

Text content: Preserve exactly 3 visible text marks: “alo” on the left-panel shirt, “alo” on the left-panel pants, and “alo” on the right-panel shirt/pants area as small brand-like markings; keep them subtle and not oversized.

Constraints: Maintain identical framing, pose, body proportions, outfit, wall placement, camera angle, and object positions between the two panels. Do not add extra people, props, captions, logos beyond the small “alo” markings, or decorative borders. Keep the face obscured with a smooth square blur in both panels.\

title: 空灵的佛教净土场景
author: 乐鱼Joyfish
categories: 插画,水墨 / 中国风,风景 / 自然,建筑 / 室内,角色
prompt_en:
The Western Paradise (also known as the Western Pure Land, Sukhavati) is the Buddha-land of Amitabha (Infinite Life Buddha). Its core characteristic is the absence of all suffering and the experience of only joy, in stark contrast to our 'enduring' (Saha) world. Located in the west of our world, ten trillion Buddha-lands away (Amitabha Sutra).

Main Buddha: Amitabha Buddha (Infinite Light, Infinite Life), who constantly preaches the Dharma; flanked by Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva and Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva, collectively known as the 'Three Sages of the West'.

Land Environment: Adorned with Seven Treasures, flawless.
Ground: Gold as the ground, flat, soft, bright, and clean, without mountains, rivers, ravines, thorns, or stones.
Seven Treasure Ponds and Eight Merit Waters: Seven treasure ponds everywhere (gold, silver, lapis lazuli, crystal, tridacna, red pearl, agate). The water possesses eight merits: sweet, cold, soft, light, clear, fragrant, thirst-quenching, and heart-nourishing. Golden sand at the bottom, seven-treasure pathways, and lotuses in the pond as large as wheels, emitting blue, yellow, red, and white light.
Architecture: Seven-treasure pavilions, palaces, and lecture halls, floating in the air, changing size at will, transparent and bright, countless times better than the heavenly realms.
Precious Trees and Heavenly Music: Seven rows of trees, seven rows of railings, seven rows of nets, all made of four treasures. The wind blows through the trees and nets, producing subtle Dharma sounds like hundreds of thousands of instruments playing together, naturally leading listeners to mindfulness of Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha.
Climate and Heavenly Rain: No heat or cold, no wind or rain, always mild and comfortable; Mandarava flowers rain down from the sky six times a day and night, fragrant and colorful.
Marvelous Birds: White cranes, peacocks, parrots, Kalavinkas, etc., all manifested by the Buddha to produce harmonious sounds proclaiming the Dharma.

Sentient Beings: No suffering, only joy, infinite lifespan.
Rebirth: Beings are born from lotus flowers in the seven treasure ponds, not from parents, free from the suffering of birth, aging, sickness, and death.
Appearance: Purple-gold bodies, majestic and solemn, similar to Amitabha Buddha; possessing five supernatural powers: heavenly eye, heavenly ear, telepathy, past-life recall, and spiritual travel, free and unobstructed.
Lifespan: Immeasurable kalpas, nearly eternal, without early death or aging.
Nature: All are superior good people, free from greed, anger, ignorance, jealousy, or conflict; compassionate, equal, wise, and pure, constantly hearing the Dharma.
Life: Clothing and food manifest naturally without labor; in the morning, one can visit ten trillion Buddha-lands to offer to Buddhas and return by mealtime.

Time and Space: Infinite and Eternal.
Time: No day or night, no months or years, eternal happiness; the world does not undergo the changes of formation, existence, decay, and void.
Space: Vast and boundless, never crowded even with beings from all ten directions; a single grain of dust can contain three thousand great worlds.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical Chinese filming-direction storyboard infographic for a high-speed train short video, showing how to shoot a passenger in a slightly uncomfortable state from farther away.

Canvas: Tall portrait layout, about 3:4 ratio, white background, black and dark-brown Chinese typography, clean documentary storyboard style.

Text content: Use the visible Chinese copy from 镜头1｜远一点拍出不适状态; 一、机位示意图（俯视图）; 窗户; 人物; 座椅; 包; 过道; 机位; 二、预期画面（示意图）; 拍摄要点; 机位放在过道斜前方; 画面带到座椅、窗户和包; 人物轻捂小腹，表情微微不适; 不要拍得太夸张，像真实乘客状态.

Layout: At the top, place a large bold headline centered. Below it, create exactly 2 stacked image panels separated by a thin dotted horizontal divider. Panel 1 is labeled as a camera-position diagram from an overhead perspective. Panel 2 is labeled as the expected shot preview. At the bottom, add a pale cream rounded rectangle notes box with a brown pill-shaped label on the left and a simple yellow lightbulb icon on the right.

Panel 1 subject and composition: Draw an illustrated overhead/three-quarter view inside a high-speed train carriage. A young woman with long dark hair and a deliberately blurred face sits by the window on a dark navy-blue train seat with a white headrest cover. She wears a cream cardigan or sweater, light blue jeans, and white sneakers. Her left hand rests over her lower abdomen to suggest mild discomfort, and her right hand reaches toward a small beige backpack placed on the adjacent seat. Show a large train window to her left with motion-blurred green scenery outside, blue paired seats around her, armrests, and the aisle on the right. Include exactly 6 white rounded callout labels with blue borders and small pointer dots: window, person, seat, bag, aisle, and camera position. Place a black DSLR-style camera on the aisle floor in the lower right foreground. Add exactly 3 directional graphics in this panel: one thick red arrow from the camera toward the seated passenger/bag area, one thick red curved arrow indicating the aisle direction, and one yellow dashed arrow pointing from the camera toward the subject.

Panel 2 subject and composition: Create a realistic cinematic preview frame from the camera angle in the aisle diagonally in front of the passenger. The woman sits in the left-center by the train window, face blurred, one hand lightly holding her abdomen, the other hand near or on the beige backpack on the neighboring seat. Keep the dark blue seats, white headrest covers, beige interior wall, large window with motion-blurred city/green scenery, long aisle receding into the background, and a small monitor screen at the far end of the carriage. The mood should be natural and restrained, not melodramatic.

Bottom notes box: Include exactly 4 bullet points, matching the shooting guidance text. Use a warm cream background, brown label badge, dark text, and a minimal yellow outline lightbulb icon.

Visual style: Semi-realistic storyboard illustration mixed with clean instructional infographic design, soft lighting, slightly textured digital painting, precise callouts, realistic high-speed rail interior, clear teaching-diagram readability. Avoid watermarks, logos, or extra panels.\

Panel 4 is a narrow lower-left close-up panel. Panel 5 is a larger lower-middle/right cooking-action panel. Panel 6 is a wide full-width reaction panel at the bottom.

Character 1 is a young Japanese-style girl with long black hair, hairpins, white blouse, and navy apron; she leads the cooking and appears in panels 1, 2, and 5. In the generated look, faces are obscured by soft square blur blocks, but body language and costumes remain visible.

Panel details:
- Panel 1: The main confectioner stands behind a wooden counter with arms open, presenting ingredients. Count exactly 2 ingredient bowls: one large bowl piled with glossy red adzuki beans in the center, and one smaller bowl of white powder on the right. Add 4 text elements: a right speech bubble saying 「先日のクエストのお礼に、私の世界の『和菓子』を作ります！」, a left speech bubble saying 「用意したのは、この小豆っていうのと…こちらが砂糖代わりに使えそうな粉」, a label card by the beans saying 「バナシウスの絆　一般的に花の中身として使用されている」, and a label card by the powder saying 「エリドゥ粉　この世界での甘味料の一つ。」
- Panel 2: The main confectioner stirs a steaming pot of red beans. Add 1 speech bubble saying 「洗ったバナシウスをじっくり茹でてまっすぐ柔らかくします」.
- Panel 3: The three guests watch from a counter or doorway, curious and impressed. Add 2 speech bubbles: one from the elf saying 「ただの豆を茹でて菓子になるの…？」 and one from the lavender-haired guest saying 「ふんふん、あんな味味わものが美味いわけが…」.
- Panel 4: Close-up of steaming red beans being drained in a basket or strainer over a pot, with vapor rising. Add 1 large sound effect: 「ザッ…」.
- Panel 5: The main confectioner smiles while pouring white powder into a pan of beans and stirring with a wooden spatula. Show the paste thickening and becoming glossy. Add 3 text elements: a speech bubble saying 「ここにエリドゥ粉を加えて、焦げ付かないようにじっくり練りながら煮詰めます！」, a pouring sound effect 「ドサッ」, and stirring/thickening sound effects 「コトコト…」 and 「トロリ…」.

Add exactly 2 text elements: a pink wavy reaction sound 「ぐぅ～～」 near the elf, and a right speech bubble saying 「あら……？なんだか、とても甘い香りがしてきましたよ……？」

title: 饲养白马的电影西部女牛仔
author: @PROMPT アトリエ｜AI画像プロンプト
categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,网红 / 模特,动物 / 生物
prompt_en:
Subject:
A cowgirl on a white horse running through the desert.

Person/Expression:
A early 20s woman. Long brown hair with thin bangs, tips flowing naturally in the wind. Translucent skin, natural Japanese-style makeup, pale rose complexion, clear eyes. The expression is slightly defiant, with her gaze directed toward the front-left of the screen. A Western cowgirl atmosphere that retains sweetness while showing strength.

Clothing/Pose:
A brown cowboy hat, a white to ivory Western shirt lightly opened at the chest and tied at the waist. A simple black bikini top inside. Blue distressed denim shorts, a decorative brown leather belt, and long brown cowboy boots. Riding a beautiful white Thoroughbred-style horse that is rearing up powerfully on its hind legs. The person's left hand stabilizes her body near the reins, and her right arm is extended straight toward the upper-left of the screen, holding a classic revolver. Hips are firmly in the saddle, one foot is in the stirrup, and her clothes and hair are swaying lightly in the wind.

Background/Light:
A dry desert like the American West. The foreground has sand, pebbles, low grass, and thin dust rising. Dry shrubs are scattered in the midground, with reddish-brown rocky mountains and mesas spreading horizontally in the background. The sky is a vivid blue with a few white clouds. Strong midday sunlight shines from the upper-right of the screen, creating bright highlights on the white horse's neck, the person's face, shoulders, shirt, and denim. Shadows fall toward the lower-left, with reflected light in the ground dust.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 9:16. A dynamic composition with the horse and person placed large in the center, and the white horse's head and forelegs extending to the top. The person is positioned to be visible on the left side of the horse, with her upper body and extended arm breaking into the sky. A slightly low-angle perspective emphasizes the horse's power and the expanse of the sky. A near full-body composition including the horse's hind legs, tail, and dust. Focus is on the person's face, the white horse's head, and the leather harness, with the background rocky mountains slightly softened.

Texture/Style:
Realistic fashion photo style. Naturally expresses high-definition skin texture, the white horse's coat, leather saddle and reins, denim wear, and thin wrinkles in the shirt. Saturation is bright, with clear tones where the blue sky, white horse, and reddish-brown desert stand out. Not over-processed, but a natural 3D feel and gloss like an outdoor location photo.

Negative:
Unnatural faces or gazes, extra fingers, missing fingers, fusion of hands and feet, broken joints, incorrect number of horse legs, poor contact with harnesses, person floating from the saddle, distorted shapes of guns or reins, unnatural gravity, shadows inconsistent with light sources, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, background text, logos, watermarks, UI, unnecessary people.\

author: ToroJushiAi
categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,肖像 / 自拍,建筑 / 室内
prompt_en: Authentic daily life photography, natural candid moment. A medium-close portrait of a young woman leaning with one shoulder against the deep dark-redwood surround of a large carved wooden lattice window in the interior wall of a classical Suzhou garden hall. The window's geometric diamond pattern is behind and to her left, its carved redwood frame very dark and ornate. Through the window panes, the bright exterior garden is visible — white plaster, green plantings, a glimpse of sky — in sharp overexposed contrast to the dim interior. She is looking sideways through the window, chin slightly tilted, expression unreadable and cool. East Asian young woman in her early 20s. Eyes directed sideways through the window with a distant, cool quality — not performing for camera. Straight refined nose. Skin fair, and in the dim interior ambient light the skin takes on a softer, lower-contrast rendering than in outdoor scenes — quiet and slightly shadowed, with definition coming from the lateral window light rather than direct illumination. Hair down, straight, tucked behind one ear, the other side falling forward. Light elegant makeup: softly defined brows, lips in a muted cool rose, minimal coverage overall. Skin subsurface scattering visible in the lateral window light catching her near cheek and temple, specular micro-highlight on the cheekbone facing the window, fine foundation powder grain perceptible. She wears an oversized light grey linen button-down shirt — worn open over a white cropped inner tank, the shirt sleeves rolled to the elbow, hem loose and untucked over high-waisted black wide-leg trousers with a clean, structured waistband. White leather low-top sneakers. The shirt carries the soft wrinkled texture of washed linen — lived-in, deliberately casual. The carved dark redwood lattice window surround beside and behind her is enormously detailed: repetitive geometric diamond-coin patterns, old dark wood, a form of craftsmanship that belongs to a different century. The grey linen and black trouser against the dark carved wood creates a tonal field that is textured, cool, modern-meets-ancient. Two or three fine hairs have drifted forward across the shoulder from the tucked side. Light enters through the ornate window from the bright garden exterior, creating a strongly directional lateral beam inside the dim hall — warm exterior garden light crossing to illuminate the near side of the subject's face, the far side falling into the cool interior shade. The window's geometric pattern projects no shadow on the subject directly (she is beside it, not in front), but the light quality is shaped by the window's proximity: directional, architectural, intimate. The old carved wood is in near-shadow. Subtle ISO 400 film grain in the dark redwood frame's deeper tones and in the cool shadow side of the subject's face, photographic noise texture not CG\

title: 女性机器人 vs 机器蝎子
author: カーブミラー
prompt_en: Create a cinematic vertical sci-fi action illustration of a female android warrior aboard a spaceship in a devastated spacecraft corridor during a hull breach. The central subject is a sleek feminine android in glossy white segmented biomechanical armor, athletic build, kneeling and twisting in a dynamic combat pose, with very long flowing silver-white hair streaming wildly in zero gravity; her face is intentionally obscured by a soft square blur or visor-like neutral mask so no facial features are visible. She holds a glowing blue-white energy blade or plasma sword diagonally across the foreground, striking a massive black mechanical scorpion enemy. The enemy is one giant robotic scorpion with two large claw arms, a heavy armored body, multiple articulated legs, and one arched segmented tail ending in a sharp stinger with a red glowing tip; include red sensor lights in its head and tail. Show bright sparks exploding where the blade hits the scorpion claw, with flying shrapnel, metallic debris, shattered glass, electrical arcs, and star-like particles filling the scene. The setting is the dark interior of a futuristic spaceship with exposed panels, cables, grated metal floor, warning screens, and a huge torn opening to outer space behind them; through the breach, show Earth’s blue curve and a starfield. Include exactly two visible warning displays on the left wall, with readable red text such as HULL BREACH / SECTOR 7-A / WARNING. Use dramatic wide-angle perspective, intense motion, high contrast, cold blue rim light from space, red emergency highlights, volumetric particles, hyper-detailed hard-surface mecha design, photorealistic anime-real sci-fi concept art, ultra-detailed metal scratches and reflections, cinematic depth of field, no extra characters, no watermark, no captions beyond the warning displays.\

title: 黑暗幻想内心怪物海报
author: 五島 雅｜Goshima Production
categories: 海报 / 传单,漫画 / 分镜,动漫 / 漫画,插画,肖像 / 自拍,角色,动物 / 生物
prompt_en: A dark fantasy gothic poster in a vertical composition, painted in a highly detailed anime-inspired style with dramatic lighting and rich texture. At the center is a beautiful young woman with long straight silver-white hair, pale skin, and an elegant, calm but dangerous presence. Her face is mostly obscured in shadow and mystery. She wears an ornate black-and-deep-blue crystalline dress with lace, feathered and jagged organic details, semi-transparent flowing sleeves, and glowing blue highlights across the bodice and collar, as if infused with magic. Her right hand is raised slightly with an open gesture, while her left hand rests lower near her waist. Surrounding and partly growing from her are luminous blue butterflies and shard-like petals, creating a sense of transformation and corruption. Behind her looms a gigantic monstrous entity made of darkness, ink, smoke, and cosmic texture, with exactly 7 glowing blue eyes visible and a huge fanged grin packed with sharp icy-blue teeth. The creature feels Lovecraftian, predatory, and intimate, curling around her like a guardian, curse, or inner demon. The palette is dominated by black, midnight navy, indigo, and electric blue, with sparkling highlights like stars or wet paint splatter. Add a decorative antique silver filigree border in all 4 corners and along the edges, making it feel like a sinister book cover or exhibition poster. Place large Japanese title text at the top: 私の中のバケモノ. Add 8 blocks of vertical Japanese copy around the figure, 4 on the left and 4 on the right, in elegant white Mincho-style type. Left side text blocks, top to bottom: 「創造の源、すべてを壊し、すべてを生む。」, 「正しさよりも、心が動く瞬間を信じる。」, 「美しいものに飢えている。」, 「静けさの中で、世界をかき混ぜる。」. Right side text blocks, top to bottom: 「感情を深く、人の痛みも、希望も、まるごと抱きしめる。」, 「枠を壊し、誰も見たことのない景色を描きたい。」, 「怖い、危ない、それでも止められない。」, plus a short atmospheric handwritten-style accent near the mid-right edge. At the lower center, add a large Japanese question line: これは、力？それとも、呪い？. At the very bottom, add a smaller Japanese line: 私の中のバケモノは、私だけの物語を待っている。. Make the whole image feel obsessive, beautiful, unsettling, and emotionally intense, like a high-end dark art poster about inner monsters and creative power.\

title: 羊睡前魅力海报
author: chi Okey
categories: 海报 / 传单,插画,水彩,角色,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dreamy Japanese bedtime charm poster featuring a sheep-themed girl and gentle good-luck message.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 illustration, soft parchment-cream background with watercolor texture, delicate gold celestial arcs, tiny stars, sparkles, and faint botanical flourishes around the edges.

Layout: Place one young girl on the left third, cropped from about knees upward, reaching her right hand forward toward the viewer in a friendly pointing gesture. The right two-thirds are reserved for elegant Japanese typography centered vertically, with decorative gold divider lines and small ornaments. Keep the composition airy, warm, and bedtime-themed.

Subject details: The girl wears a fluffy white sheep-ear hood over wavy light brown hair, a pale sage-green long-sleeve dress with small white daisy pattern and gathered waist, and carries a woven wicker basket in her left hand. The basket has exactly 1 sheep-face plush charm attached to the front. Her face is intentionally obscured by a plain flat beige square mask with no facial features. Behind her on the far left is exactly 1 large golden crescent moon. Add white daisies and soft foliage near the lower left and lower right corners.

Text content: Use Japanese text exactly as follows. Large headline on the upper right: 「ひつじのおまじない」 followed by exactly 1 pink faceted heart icon. Below it, two centered lines: 「今日ラッキーだった事を」 and 「ひとつ思い出してから寝よう」 with 「ラッキー」 highlighted in soft pink while the rest is warm brown. Under the message place exactly 1 tiny gold sheep icon between short decorative horizontal lines and sparkles.

Visual style: Soft watercolor and gouache storybook illustration, warm beige and muted sage palette, gold ink accents, delicate magical bedtime atmosphere, elegant hand-drawn Japanese calligraphy, subtle grain, gentle lighting, no harsh outlines.

Constraints: Include exactly these countable main elements: 1 girl, 1 sheep-ear hood, 1 sage daisy dress, 1 wicker basket, 1 sheep plush charm, 1 crescent moon, 1 pink heart icon, 1 tiny gold sheep icon, 2 main message lines, and 1 headline. Do not add extra characters, animals, logos, watermarks, or additional large text.\

prompt_en: A soft pastel watercolor anime illustration of a young elf girl sitting on a bed in a quiet sunlit bedroom, viewed from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. She has warm orange shoulder-length hair with soft layered strands, large blue eyes, pale skin, and long pointed elf ears. A red flower hair clip decorates the left side of her hair. Her expression is calm and dreamy as she gazes upward toward the bright light on the right side of the image. She wears a loose sage-green chiffon dress with ruffled trim, sheer puffed long sleeves, gathered ribbon details at the chest, and a black lace camisole visible underneath, plus a thin red choker with a small pendant and dark thigh-high stockings. She is posed seated near the edge of a lavender bedspread, leaning back with both hands resting on the mattress behind her, legs extended diagonally toward the lower right. The room is delicate and minimal: 1 bed with 2 white pillows, 1 wooden headboard or bedside surface behind her, 1 window on the left, 1 small potted plant on the windowsill, and flowing lavender curtains. Strong warm sunlight floods the scene from the right, creating a large glowing white area and gentle washed-out highlights. Use an airy handmade watercolor look with visible paper grain, soft bleeding edges, pastel lilac and cream shadows, subtle sparkled pigment texture, and a serene fantasy slice-of-life mood.\

prompt_en: Create a dark, cinematic anime-style portrait of a young marionette woman seated upright like a suspended puppet, framed from head to thighs in a vertical composition. She has short wavy dark teal hair with warm copper tips, a delicate neck, bare shoulders, and wears a pale ruffled lolita ballet tutu dress with puffed sheer sleeves, a fitted bodice, frilled neckline, and layered skirt. Her face is deliberately hidden by a centered opaque dark square, making her identity anonymous and unsettling. Four long black marionette strings descend vertically from the top of the frame around her body, two crossing near the left side and two falling straight near the right, emphasizing that she is controlled. The dress is filled with dozens of glowing golden butterfly-shaped lights, concentrated across the bodice, waist, and skirt, casting warm amber illumination through translucent fabric and onto her skin. title: 深红色口音哥特式新娘礼服
author: 空想製作所/AI４コマ漫画
categories: 电影感 / 电影剧照,插画,肖像 / 自拍,建筑 / 室内
prompt_en: A dramatic full-body fantasy bridal portrait of a young woman standing in a ruined gothic cathedral, viewed from a slightly low angle to emphasize the grandeur of the dress. She wears an elaborate wedding gown with a fitted white corset bodice, delicate lace embroidery, off-shoulder lace details, and long translucent lace gloves. The skirt is extremely voluminous and layered with cascading ruffles, sheer fabric, and lace-trimmed panels, featuring a striking deep crimson red to white gradient concentrated toward the lower inner layers and center front, with rich red fabric visible beneath the white overskirt. Add red rose clusters and ribbon accents at the waist and down the front of the gown, plus a large floral hair ornament made of white flowers and red roses. Her dark wine red hair is styled in a soft updo with loose strands, and she wears a long cathedral veil edged with intricate lace that spreads behind her. In one hand she holds or rests near a bouquet of red and white roses. Surround her with floating rose petals, mostly red with a few white petals, creating a cinematic sense of motion. The setting is a vast abandoned cathedral interior with towering pointed arches, broken tracery windows, weathered stone, climbing vines, and soft daylight streaming through the openings. The mood is elegant, ethereal, romantic, and slightly gothic, with ultra-detailed fabric rendering, realistic lace texture, soft glow, high contrast, and polished painterly-photoreal fantasy illustration. Keep the red accents clean, luxurious, and floral rather than smeared, avoiding any blood-like appearance.\
